subject: Discovery call recap - FintechX POC & onboarding plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@fintechx.com>, Michael Lopez <m.lopez@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery call recap - FintechX POC & onboarding plan

Hi Ava / Michael —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap of what we heard and the proposed next steps so we’re all aligned. Please flag anything I missed or got wrong.

Key pain points you described:
- Search relevance drift: current ElasticSearch + in-house embeddings returns noisy results for financial regulatory content.
- Latency spikes during peak batch scoring windows that impact user experience.
- Cost unpredictability for embedding throughput (large corpus refreshes).

Current stack (we captured):
- Backend: Node.js microservices on AWS (ECS/Fargate), some Python batch jobs for ETL.
- Search: ElasticSearch with custom scoring layers; embeddings computed offline and stored in Redis/ES.
- Auth/data: internal tenant separation, data stored in AWS (us-west-2).

Success criteria for PoC (your input + our suggestions):
- Functional: fresher, more relevant search/rerank results for regulatory doc corpus.
- Performance: 95th/99th percentile latency for online reranking under 500ms.
- Cost: predictable per-embedding unit costs and demonstrable unit-cost improvement vs current pipeline.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 evidence and clear data handling commitments for PII-sensitive docs.

Proposed PoC scope and milestones (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, scope finalization, access & NDAs.
- Week 1: Integration (embed pipeline + small live test): SDK in Node + Python examples, sample data ingestion, baseline metrics.
- Week 2: Model validation & tuning: relevance evaluations, simple prompt/embedding experiments.
- Week 3: Load/perf testing and security questionnaire responses (SOC 2 artifacts).
- Week 4: Review results, decision meeting (go/no-go), and next steps for production roll-out.

Integration details / technical notes:
- SDKs: Redwood provides first-class SDKs for Python and Node.js; REST API available for direct calls.
- Endpoints: embedding endpoint for nearest-neighbor search, and generation/chat endpoints if you want to prototype assistant flows later.
- API compatibility: standard REST/JSON with API keys; can support VPC/private deployment for data residency if needed.
- Sandbox: we’ll provide a short-lived sandbox API key and a sample Postman collection from our SE (Logan).

Owners / point people:
- FintechX: Ava Thompson (product lead), Michael Lopez (engineering lead)
- Redwood: Aditya Rao (AE, owner of PoC), Logan Wright (SE, technical owner), Marissa Cole (CS, onboarding)

Proposed next meeting: Tue Mar 10, 10:00 AM PST — 30 minutes to finalize access and sign-off on the PoC map.

Attachments: Redwood-Integration-Guide-v1.pdf (integration checklist), 20260303-POC-MAP-fintechx.xlsx (milestones & owners).

Next steps for you:
1) Confirm the PoC scope and proposed timeframe above.
2) Share the list of sample datasets (or a sanitized slice) we should use in Week 1.
3) Confirm availability for the proposed meeting or suggest an alternate time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: Redwood-Integration-Guide-v1.pdf (19 pages), 20260303-POC-MAP-fintechx.xlsx (3 sheets)

From: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@fintechx.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Lopez <m.lopez@fintechx.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - FintechX POC & onboarding plan

Thanks for the clear recap, Aditya — this looks right to me. A few clarifications from our side:

Primary use case: improve relevance and freshness for regulatory search queries (we run daily corpus updates). We also want to evaluate reranking embeddings to see if we can reduce downstream user clicks to find the first relevant doc.

Additional notes:
- We do a nightly batch to recompute embeddings for ~1.2M documents; ideally the PoC will show a path to reduce that cost or the need for full re-embeds.
- Security: SOC 2 is required — please share the SOC 2 report and any related security artifacts in Week 1 if possible. We’ll need a data processing addendum for our legal team.
- Data residency: for the PoC it’s fine to run in us-west-2 but for production we’ll need confirmation around encryption at rest and key management options.

Timeline: the 4-week plan works. I can confirm the kickoff meeting — Tue Mar 10 at 10:00 AM PST works for our team.

Sample data: I’ll have Michael share a sanitized sample slice (about 5k docs) by EOD Friday.

Thanks — looking forward to the sandbox key and the Postman collection.

Best,
Ava Thompson
Head of Product | FintechX
ava.thompson@fintechx.com | +1 (617) 444-2200

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@fintechx.com>, Michael Lopez <m.lopez@fintechx.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - FintechX POC & onboarding plan

Quick technical follow-up from the SE side:

- SDKs: we’ll share a Node example that hooks into your existing Node microservice for live reranking (small wrapper, ~10 lines to call embedding + cosine-ranking). Python SDK will be useful for batch ETL jobs — we’ll include examples for both.
- Sandbox key & test dataset: I’ll provision a scoped sandbox API key (embeddings + rerank) and upload a Postman collection and a small sample dataset to the shared Drive folder.
- Data handling: embeddings computed via our service can be stored in your Redis/ES. If you want us to host the vector index, we can do that behind a VPC for the Private deployment track.

I’ll add the Postman collection link to the Drive folder and post a short runbook. Expect the sandbox key and the collection today.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - FintechX POC & onboarding plan

Ava — thanks for the quick confirmation.

I’ve scheduled the kickoff: Tue Mar 10, 10:00 AM - 10:30 AM PST (invite sent). Agenda will be: 1) access & NDA checks, 2) confirm PoC dataset, 3) handoff to Logan for sandbox & ingestion plan.

Next immediate actions (we’ll track these in the shared PoC map):
- FintechX: share sanitized 5k doc sample (Michael) — due Fri Mar 6 EOD.
- Redwood: share SOC 2 summary + security artifacts (Marissa) — due Wed Mar 4.
- Redwood SE: sandbox key + Postman collection (Logan) — due today.
- AE: finalize and share kickoff agenda + calendar invite (Aditya) — done.

Looking forward to the kickoff — we’ll use the Drive folder to keep artifacts and the HubSpot deal updated.

Best,
Aditya
